column1: # ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES.54 (a) — the LR-elimination bisect, GRAMMAR axis isolated.
# left_recursion_eliminated is a function of TWO inputs — the grammar and the elimination
# pass — so "which commit moved it" is ambiguous until one axis is held still. Every
# grammars/systemverilog.ebnf revision since 2026-08-14 was extracted with
# `git show <rev>:grammars/systemverilog.ebnf` and linted with ONE FIXED binary, which makes
# any transition necessarily a grammar edit.
#   for c in $(git log --format='%h' --since=2026-08-14 -- grammars/systemverilog.ebnf | tac); do
# The transition is at 958fcc24 (PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0261, leaf SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2y,
# ledger SV-0066, release 1.0.193), which moved the `implies` property operator into the
# prop_until_sv_* cascade and deleted `property_expr implies property_expr` — so
# property_expr's CYCLE ceased to exist rather than stopping being handled.
